name: shortest_path_weighted
author: 91f2b762
description: Finds the cheapest route between two nodes using Dijkstra's algorithm, where the cost of a route is the sum of its edge weights. Use for questions like 'what is the shortest route by distance from A to B?' or 'what is the cheapest path between X and Y?'. Works on directed graphs (follows edge direction) and undirected graphs; weights must be non-negative. In 'airports' the weight is distance in km; in unweighted graphs every edge costs 1, so it gives the fewest hops. Returns the total distance, the number of hops and the path as a list of nodes with id and label. Returns an error if there is no path. Needs node ids: call lookup_node first if you only have names.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'airports' or 'lesmis'.

source.description: Node id where the route starts, e.g. 'MAA'. Use lookup_node to find it from a name.

target.description: Node id where the route ends, e.g. 'LIS'. Use lookup_node to find it from a name.
